figurative_meaning_en: No more to say; the conversation is over
example_sentences_in_bangla: তুমি যা বলতে চেয়েছ, গল্প শেষ।
এখন আর বিতর্ক নেই, গল্প শেষ।
example_sentences_in_english: You've heard everything, end of story.
No more arguments; that's the end of the discussion.
note: Commonly used in oral Bengali communication to signify finality.
